name: chronicle
description: Turns a brief plus facts gathered from GitHub, Jira, Confluence, Datadog or pasted notes into an illustrated, interactive story page designed for its subject: a theme, progress bar, paper and words from the subject's world, checked against other pages so no two look alike, ink-and-watercolor drawings painted in code, editorial charts, maps, flows, diagrams, quizzes, and a source behind every number.
